name: Glyphic Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, a Glyphic Tablet sends young Horde mages to Mai'ah. Gornek passes it to them after they prove their strength, and the troll trainer waits outside the Den.

sections.title: A Message in Inscribed Stone
sections.body: You have proved your strength against the Valley of Trials' wildlife, and Gornek gives you an inscribed tablet. Mai'ah, the valley's mage trainer, sent it. She asks you to find her by the Den's entrance when you are ready to begin your arcane studies.

sections.title: The Dangers of the Unseen
sections.body: Mai'ah speaks plainly about the power mages wield and the danger that comes with it. She warns that their greatest threat is magic's unseen pull toward corruption, not rival warriors or enemy races. Humility and patience matter, she says, because unchecked sorcery can make a mage believe they have mastered more than they have.

faq.q: Who delivers the Glyphic Tablet to the player?
aliases: where do i get glyphic tablet
faq.answer: Gornek gives you the tablet after you clear the mottled boars in the Valley of Trials.
Mai'ah is a Darkspear troll mage trainer outside the Den in the Valley of Trials. She teaches beginning Horde mages early spells and warns them about arcane corruption.
Mai'ah waits just outside the Den's entrance, to the right of the tunnel mouth in the northern Valley of Trials.

faq.q: What warning does Mai'ah give about magic?
faq.answer: Mai'ah warns that magic can corrupt those who wield it. She says mages should fear its unseen temptations and delusions of power more than physical enemies such as orcs, elves, or dwarves.

faq.q: Do other classes receive the Glyphic Tablet?
aliases: can other classes get glyphic tablet
faq.answer: No. The Glyphic Tablet is for novice mages. Other classes receive different introductory summons, such as runes, scrolls, or sigils, suited to their trainers.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be met to receive this tablet?
faq.answer: You must first complete Gornek's opening task by slaying mottled boars across the red dirt flats of the Valley of Trials.

angles.text: As a mage, you receive a formal welcome among Horde spellcasters from the valley's trainer. Mai'ah teaches the discipline needed to control raw magic.
As a Darkspear troll, your training with Mai'ah reflects your tribe's growing use of formal spellcasting alongside its traditional spiritual rites.
As an orc, you take up a rare path under Mai'ah. Orcish culture has long been shaped by shamans and warriors, and few of your people have tried the arcane.
